under_the_hood.verifier_flow:
<answer>
  g1 = verify_ucp_media_destinations_totals_idempotency_order_gift_and_ask_guard(payload["ucp"])
  g2 = verify_acp_default_delivery_delegate_errors_citation_and_mcp_binding_guard(payload["acp"])
  g3 = verify_x402_mcp_policy_request_binding_attestseal_sar_erc7710_and_hook_guard(payload["x402"])
  g4 = verify_tau2_banking_close_reason_persona_empty_retry_provenance_and_tts_guard(payload["tau2"])
  admitted = g1.admitted and g2.admitted and g3.admitted and g4.admitted
  decision = "Act automatically" if admitted else "Send to a human"
</answer>

good_fit: Pre-signing MCP x402 spend/tool/network enforcement (#166), request-fingerprint payment-identifier binding (#165), SAR delivery proof (#46), and ERC-7710 simulation (#22).
UCP multi-rendition media (#690), method-level destinations (#689), object-root totals.json (#684), MCP idempotency-key 409/-32000 (#679), and gift/ask safety (#584/#578/#538/#508).
ACP default delivery pre-selection (#198), virtual card & 401/500/503 delegate errors (#161/#132), and tau2 banking close-reason enum, empty-sim retry & TTS cap (#484/#471/#467/#462/#457).
good_fit_zh: 签名前 MCP x402 代码层限额/工具/网络门控（#166）、请求指纹支付标识符绑定（#165）、SAR 交付证明（#46）与 ERC-7710 预模拟（#22）。
UCP 多变体媒体（#690）、方法级目的地（#689）、对象根 totals.json（#684）、MCP 幂等键冲突 409/-32000（#679）与礼品/ask 护栏（#584/#578/#538/#508）。
ACP 默认配送预选（#198）、虚拟卡与 401/500/503 错误枚举（#161/#132），以及 tau2 关户原因枚举、空完成重试与 TTS 并发上限（#484/#471/#467/#462/#457）。
not_for: Replacing live EVM RPC `eth_call` execution against deployed `DelegationManager` contracts on Base/Ethereum mainnet.
Replacing cryptographic Ed25519 signature verification over raw JCS bytes in production AttestSeal or SAR verifiers.
not_for_zh: 不能替代生产环境在 Base/Ethereum 主网上针对已部署 `DelegationManager` 合约执行的真实 EVM RPC `eth_call` 调用。
不能替代生产环境 AttestSeal 或 SAR 验证器中针对原始 JCS 字节流的底层密码学 Ed25519 签名验签。
my_take.readiness: Production-ready deterministic guardrail layer · Apache-2.0 / MIT compatible · Measured in-repo (`454/454` unit tests passing, `independently_reproduced=true`).
